notes:
GOAT Sim Coach 0.9.196 (beta) - Phase 0 of the readiness plan

SMART
- Every lap readout now records the numbers it was built from (lap time, reference, delta, sectors) next to the words, so a drive can be checked against the session file afterwards. Nothing changes in what you hear.

Radar (iRacing)
- One placement model for both radar modes: forward is the real distance along the track, sideways follows your saved reference line through a bend, and the spotter overrides both for the car it names - drawn on that side and pulled alongside. Before this the projected mode could still draw a "car left" ten metres back on the right.

Recording
- Start checks the drive has room (about 6 GB an hour) and says so if not; a recording is stopped cleanly before the drive fills.
- If OBS sees a black picture at Start, the page says so at once instead of an hour later.
- The Highlights panel says what is recorded: your screen with the overlays; TV angles are filmed with them hidden.

Under the hood
- The release gate refuses to build or test while a sim is running, and refuses to publish without a verified driven session (sr.py verify).
- sr.py weekly writes the weekly progress summary.
